facts.text: Viking 2 Lander was deployed at Utopia Planitia during Viking 2 in 1976.

The Viking 2 lander touched down on Utopia Planitia on September 3, 1976. Supported by three titanium inverted-tripod landing legs with crushable honeycomb pads, it housed twin SNAP-19 RTGs, dual biological incubators, and S-band communications antennas.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Provided four years of continuous weather, atmospheric pressure, and surface imaging, confirming seasonal CO2 condensation and water-ice sublimation.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Utopia Planitia.
Remains in pristine condition on the northern plains of Utopia Planitia, surviving four complete Martian seasonal cycles.
